facts.text: Necker Island is situated in the North Sound of the British Virgin Islands, in the eastern Caribbean Sea.
facts.excerpt: is situated in the North Sound of the British Virgin Islands, in the eastern Caribbean Sea, to the east of Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands

facts.text: Necker Island sits in turquoise waters surrounded by coral reefs and fringed with white sandy beaches.
facts.excerpt: Necker Island sits in turquoise waters surrounded by coral reefs, fringed with beautiful white sandy beaches

facts.text: Exclusive hire of Necker Island means no other guests and no shared spaces.
facts.excerpt: No other guests, no shared spaces

facts.text: During select dates each year, guests can book an individual room or suite on Necker Island without hiring the whole island.
facts.excerpt: During select dates each year, you can book an individual room or suite on Necker Island.

facts.text: Stays are all-inclusive, covering all food and drinks, activities and water sports.
facts.excerpt: You'll experience everything Necker has to offer, from all your food and drinks to endless tailor-made activities and water sports.

facts.text: Rooms feature airy bedrooms, sun-drenched terraces and infinity pools.
facts.excerpt: Expect airy bedrooms, sun-drenched terraces, infinity pools and plenty of places to relax.

facts.text: Bedrooms and common areas channel Indonesian temples, with intricately carved wooden ceilings, zen gardens and stone Buddhas.
facts.excerpt: Bedrooms and common areas alike channel Indonesian temples with intricately carved wooden ceilings, eclectic art, serene zen gardens, sanskrit decor, and stone Buddhas.

facts.text: The hilltop Great House has far-flung views of the waters around the island.
facts.excerpt: A sprawling hilltop Great House has far-flung views of the azure waters around the island

facts.text: Guests can feed the island's lemurs with one of the keepers on site.
facts.excerpt: It's also immensely fun to feed the gentle, high-jumping lemurs with one of the keepers onsite

facts.text: The island is home to resident lemurs and flamingos that gather at their pond.
facts.excerpt: Wander far enough and you might meet the island's resident lemurs, or find the flamingos gathered at their pond.

facts.text: Water sports include snorkelling, paddleboarding, kayaking, Hobie sailing, e-foiling and seabobbing.
facts.excerpt: A wide variety of watersports: snorkelling, paddleboarding, kayaking, Hobie sailing, e-foiling, seabobbing and more

facts.text: Guests can use tennis, padel and pickleball courts, with a dedicated on-island tennis professional for lessons and coaching.
facts.excerpt: Use of the tennis, padel and pickleball courts, with access to a dedicated on-island tennis professional for lessons and coaching

facts.text: The island's onsite spa is called Samudra.
facts.excerpt: Onsite spa Samudra (meaning

facts.text: The spa offers facials, massages, scrubs and Sodashi skincare beauty treatments.
facts.excerpt: has three treatment rooms for facials, massages, scrubs, and Sodashi skincare beauty treatments

facts.text: There is an infinity pool pavilion with a hot tub and a swim-up bar.
facts.excerpt: infinity pool pavilion with hot tub and a swim-up bar

facts.text: Meals can be taken as lunch on the sand at Turtle Beach or dinner under the stars on the Great House roof terrace.
facts.excerpt: Lunch on the sand at Turtle Beach, dinner under the stars on the Great House roof terrace

facts.text: Floating sushi boats served at the pool pavilion are a Necker tradition.
facts.excerpt: floating sushi boats (a Necker tradition)

facts.text: Stays include a return boat transfer from Virgin Gorda or Beef Island airports.
facts.excerpt: Return boat transfer from Virgin Gorda or Beef Island airports

facts.text: A Kids Club runs a curated programme of activities for younger guests.
facts.excerpt: A Kids Club and curated programme of activities to keep younger guests entertained

facts.text: A boat trip to the Virgin Gorda Baths, with granite boulders and hidden rock pools, can be arranged.
facts.excerpt: a boat trip to the Virgin Gorda Baths waits, granite boulders and hidden rock pools included

facts.text: Solar panels and wind turbines help power the island.
facts.excerpt: it has wind turbines and solar panels (evident daily as you explore the property)

facts.text: The minimum stay on Necker Island is four nights.
facts.excerpt: The minimum stay length for Necker Island is four nights.

facts.text: The island is not very accessible because of its steep hills.
facts.excerpt: the island isn't exactly accessible due to steep hills

facts.text: Complimentary island hikes and yoga classes are included.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary island hikes and yoga classes

facts.text: Necker Island covers 74 acres.
facts.excerpt: At 74 acres, Necker Island sits in turquoise waters
